description: Retrieve component OPRs (COPRs) for every team at an event: per-team estimates of how much a team adds to each individual scoring component, not just total score. Returns an object keyed by component name, each a team_key→number map. Component names come from that season's score breakdown and change every year (2025 examples: 'L1 Coral Count', 'autoPoints', 'endGameBargePoints', 'foulCount'), so read the keys rather than assuming them. Computed with the same least-squares regression as OPR (see get_event_oprs) and carries the same caveats: a handful of qualification matches per team makes estimates noisy, partner and schedule effects leak in, and values can be negative or fractional even for whole-number counts. Treat them as rough signals for scouting and alliance selection, not measurements. Returns null or an empty object before qualification matches are played.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_coprs
title: Get Event Component OPRs
